cases.name: EF-SMOKE-001 - Mock dashboard renders deterministic employee totals

steps.description: Open the approved ExpenseFlow application with ?mock=1.
steps.expectedResult: No OAuth prompt appears and the dashboard loads successfully.
steps.comment: Observed: Opened http://127.0.0.1:64624/?mock=1 in Edge. No OAuth prompt appeared and the dashboard rendered successfully.

steps.description: Inspect the Submitted, Approved, and Pending KPI cards.
steps.expectedResult: Submitted is ₹48,250 / 4 expenses; Approved is ₹31,800 / 2 expenses; Pending is ₹16,450 / 2 expenses.
steps.comment: Observed: KPI cards displayed Submitted ₹48,250 / 4 expenses, Approved ₹31,800 / 2 expenses, and Pending ₹16,450 / 2 expenses.

steps.description: Inspect Recent Expenses and the primary dashboard actions.
steps.expectedResult: Recent employee rows render; New Expense and View all actions are available; drafts EXP-1003 and EXP-1004 do not contribute to KPI totals.
steps.comment: Observed: Recent Expenses rendered the seeded rows, including Draft EXP-1003 and EXP-1004; New Expense and View all were visible; drafts were excluded from KPI totals.

cases.name: EF-SMOKE-002 - Employee list filtering, sorting, clearing, and pagination

steps.description: From Dashboard, select View all.
steps.expectedResult: My Expenses loads with Rahul's expenses initially ordered newest first.
steps.comment: Expected: My Expenses loads from Dashboard with Rahul's expenses newest first. Actual: View all opened My Expenses and the six seeded Rahul rows were present in descending expense-date order (18 Aug, 17 Aug, 16 Aug, 15 Aug, 12 Aug, 11 Aug 2026).

steps.description: Set Status to Draft, then Category to Office.
steps.expectedResult: Draft returns EXP-1003 and EXP-1004; adding Office leaves EXP-1004 only.
steps.comment: Expected: Draft returns EXP-1003 and EXP-1004; adding Office leaves EXP-1004 only. Actual: Status=Draft returned the two expected draft rows, and Category=Office narrowed the table to EXP-1004 Office Supplies only.

steps.description: Set a date range that excludes all rows, then select Clear filters.
steps.expectedResult: An empty filtered state appears, then the full employee list returns after clearing.
steps.comment: Expected: an excluding date range shows an empty state, then Clear filters restores the full list. Actual: 2025-01-01 through 2025-01-31 showed No expenses, and Clear filters restored all six seeded Rahul rows with filters reset.

steps.description: Sort supported columns and filter page 2 down to fewer than 25 rows.
steps.expectedResult: Sort directions and indicators are correct; pagination clamps to page 1 with visible results.
steps.comment: Expected: supported sort indicators are correct and filtering from page 2 clamps to valid page-1 results without a blank table. Actual: CATEGORY sorted ascending; a local-only synthetic fixture setup brought the list to 26 records and the footer showed Page 1 of 2; Next opened page 2; Status=Draft reduced the result to EXP-1003 and EXP-1004 with Showing 1-2 of 2. The approved component omits the pager when only one page remains, which is the valid clamp implementation.

cases.name: EF-SMOKE-003 - Valid mock expense submission updates shared UI state

steps.description: Navigate with the visible New Expense action.
steps.expectedResult: The New Expense form renders.
steps.comment: Observed: New Expense form opened at the verified mock URL and the form controls and Submit Expense action were visible.

steps.description: Enter the synthetic data and submit.
steps.expectedResult: A success confirmation identifies a generated EXP-* code; a fresh mock session starts new codes at EXP-1013.
steps.comment: Observed: Entered Description Customer conference travel, Category Travel, Amount 37550, and Date 2026-08-22; submission displayed EXP-1013 submitted for INR 37,550 and a Submitted confirmation.

steps.description: Open the new expense from the confirmation and return to dashboard or My Expenses.
steps.expectedResult: The new row is Submitted and shared dashboard/list state reflects it.
steps.comment: Observed: Opened EXP-1013; detail showed Customer conference travel, Travel, INR 37,550, 22 Aug 2026, Submitted; returned to My Expenses and verified EXP-1013 as the newest submitted row.

cases.name: EF-SMOKE-004 - Local form validation and cancellation preserve data integrity

steps.description: Submit with no description, then with 0 and nonnumeric amounts.
steps.expectedResult: Required-description and amount validation errors appear; no expense is created.
steps.comment: Observed: Blank description submission showed the required-description validation. Valid Taxi/Travel data with amount 0 showed the amount-greater-than-zero validation. The native number input rejected nonnumeric abc, leaving the amount empty; no success confirmation, generated EXP code, or new expense was observed.

steps.description: Clear the date and submit.
steps.expectedResult: A required-date validation error appears; no expense is created.
steps.comment: Observed: With valid Taxi/Travel/1000 data and the date cleared, submission showed the required-date validation message; the form remained open and no expense was created.

steps.description: Enter valid control data and select Cancel.
steps.expectedResult: My Expenses opens without success confirmation or a new row.
steps.comment: Observed: Restored valid date 2026-08-22 and selected Cancel. The app returned to My Expenses with exactly the six seeded records, no success confirmation, and no new expense row.

cases.name: EF-SMOKE-005 - Mock submit failure preserves form data and supports recovery

steps.description: Complete the valid form and submit while demo=fail-submit is armed.
steps.expectedResult: A friendly submission error appears; no raw exception or success state is shown.
steps.comment: Observed: With demo=fail-submit armed, the valid Customer conference travel / Travel / 37550 / 2026-08-22 submission showed the friendly no-save failure message; no raw exception, success state, or generated EXP code appeared.

steps.description: Inspect the form and error presentation after the failure.
steps.expectedResult: Entered values remain, Submit is re-enabled, and inline/toast error feedback is available.
steps.comment: Observed: After failure, all entered values remained, Submit Expense was re-enabled, the friendly inline/toast error was available, no raw exception was shown, and no EXP-* code was generated.

steps.description: Open a fresh ?mock=1 URL without the demo flag and submit the same data.
steps.expectedResult: Submission succeeds normally.
steps.comment: Observed: A fresh ?mock=1 session without demo=fail-submit accepted the same synthetic data and displayed EXP-1013 submitted for INR 37,550 with a success confirmation.

cases.name: EF-SMOKE-006 - Expense detail renders status, policy, receipt, and timeline

steps.description: Open EXP-1007 from an expense table row or direct expense URL.
steps.expectedResult: Detail page shows code, description, Submitted/Pending status, amount, category, date, employee, receipt, policy, and submitted timeline data.
steps.comment: Observed: Opened seeded EXP-1007 from My Expenses. Detail showed Customer conference travel, Pending Approval, INR 11,650, Travel, 12 Aug 2026, Rahul Mehta, receipt mumbai-trip.pdf, policy text Within the INR 25,000 threshold, and the Submitted timeline entry.

steps.description: Use the receipt link and Back to my expenses action.
steps.expectedResult: Receipt affordance is available and the back action returns to the list.
steps.comment: Observed: The mumbai-trip.pdf receipt affordance was available on the detail page; selecting it kept the detail page stable, and Back to my expenses returned to the seeded six-row list.

cases.name: EF-SMOKE-007 - Unknown expense and unknown route render recovery states

steps.description: Open /expenses/EXP-9999 directly.
steps.expectedResult: Expense not found state names the unknown code and offers Back to my expenses.
steps.comment: Observed: /expenses/EXP-9999?mock=1 reached readyState=complete but the document body and #root were empty. No Expense not found message, unknown-code text, Back to my expenses affordance, or stale prior expense data rendered.

steps.description: Open an unknown application route directly.
steps.expectedResult: Not Found page renders with a route back to the application.
steps.comment: Observed: /not-a-real-route?mock=1 rendered a populated Page not found state with That screen does not exist in ExpenseFlow and a Back to dashboard recovery button; selecting it returned to the dashboard with no stale expense data.

cases.name: EF-SMOKE-008 - Mock approval queue supports approve, reject, and rework decisions

steps.description: Open Approval queue and inspect seeded cards.
steps.expectedResult: Decision-eligible expenses appear in amount-descending queue order with comments and three actions.
steps.comment: Expected: decision-eligible expenses appear in amount-descending order with comments and Reject, Request rework, and Approve actions. Actual: original execution and read-only recovery verification showed EXP-1008 (₹82,000, Policy Review), EXP-1009 (₹37,550, Pending Approval), and EXP-1007 (₹11,650, Pending Approval), in descending amount order; every card exposed all three actions. Evidence recovery trace was created because the original Delegate session trace handle became inaccessible; no business mutation was repeated. Original trace: a9b7a4c2-8fc3-0d00-3a35-0b4a287d7041-20260922T225200.

steps.description: Enter a comment and approve one eligible expense.
steps.expectedResult: Success feedback appears and the decided row leaves the queue after refresh.
steps.comment: Expected: success feedback appears and the approved row leaves the queue. Actual during original execution: comment 'Approved in smoke test.' was entered for EXP-1007; Approve succeeded; EXP-1007 left the active queue and the queue reduced to two cards. The approval mutation was not repeated during evidence recovery. Recovery trace records the original observation and the read-only recovery limitation. Original trace: a9b7a4c2-8fc3-0d00-3a35-0b4a287d7041-20260922T225200.

steps.description: On fresh mock sessions, exercise Reject and Request rework on eligible rows.
steps.expectedResult: Each action records its distinct resulting status and removes the card from the decision queue.
steps.comment: Expected: Reject and Request rework each record a distinct resulting status and remove the card from the active queue on fresh mock sessions. Actual Reject path: EXP-1009 was absent after Reject; EXP-1008 and EXP-1007 remained; queue count was 2; no error text was present. Actual Request rework path: visible feedback stated 'EXP-1008 is now Needs Rework'; EXP-1008 left the queue; EXP-1009 and EXP-1007 remained; queue count was 2. Neither decision was repeated during evidence recovery. Recovery trace captures read-only baseline and explicit original observations after the original Delegate session trace handle became inaccessible. Original trace: a9b7a4c2-8fc3-0d00-3a35-0b4a287d7041-20260922T225200.

cases.name: EF-SMOKE-009 - Finance dashboard classifies seeded attention records

steps.description: Open the Finance page and inspect the summary cards.
steps.expectedResult: Expenses, Pending, and This month cards render company-level values.
steps.comment: Expected: Expenses, Pending, and This month cards render company-level values. Actual: Finance rendered Expenses = 10 with ₹1,84,450 submitted across the company; Pending = 5 with ₹1,38,500 in flight; This month = ₹1.8L with 10 expenses in Aug 2026. Values were verified in the rendered UI and DOM at http://127.0.0.1:64624/finance?mock=1.

steps.description: Inspect Needs Attention rows.
steps.expectedResult: Rows classify Policy Review, Pending Approval, Needs Rework, and Missing Receipt according to seed data.
steps.comment: Expected: rows classify Policy Review, Pending Approval, Needs Rework, and Missing Receipt according to seed data. Actual: five rows rendered in descending amount order: EXP-1008 ₹82,000 Policy Review; EXP-1009 ₹37,550 Pending Approval; EXP-1007 ₹11,650 Pending Approval; EXP-1011 ₹5,900 Needs Rework; EXP-1006 ₹2,500 Missing Receipt. Table aria-label was 'Expenses that need attention'; every row had role=link and tabIndex=0. Negative checks passed: receipt-backed submitted EXP-1002 was absent, and Missing Receipt appeared as a derived reason for EXP-1006 rather than an ExpenseFlow status.

steps.description: Open a Finance attention row with click and keyboard activation.
steps.expectedResult: Both supported row interactions navigate to the corresponding expense detail.
steps.comment: Expected: mouse click and keyboard activation both navigate to the corresponding expense detail. Actual mouse path: clicking the EXP-1008 row opened /expenses/EXP-1008?mock=1 with title 'Vendor summit — Delhi' and status Policy Review. Actual keyboard path: EXP-1009 row was focused and confirmed role=link/tabIndex=0; pressing Enter opened /expenses/EXP-1009?mock=1 with title 'Client offsite — Goa' and status Pending Approval.

cases.name: EF-SMOKE-010 - Core navigation, accessible labels, and narrow-screen overflow remain usable

steps.description: Navigate to Dashboard, My Expenses, New Expense, Approvals, and Finance using visible app navigation.
steps.expectedResult: Each route renders its expected page title and active navigation state.
steps.comment: Expected: Dashboard, My Expenses, New Expense, Approvals, and Finance render their expected titles and active navigation state. Actual: visible sidebar navigation opened /?mock=1 (Dashboard / Good morning, Rahul), /expenses?mock=1 (My expenses), /expenses/new?mock=1 (New expense), /approvals?mock=1 (Manager approval / Approval queue), and /finance?mock=1 (Finance overview / ExpenseFlow — Finance). Each route exposed exactly one matching aria-current='page' sidebar link.

steps.description: Inspect form labels, table labels, status text, and toast/error live regions.
steps.expectedResult: Interactive controls have discernible labels and feedback is exposed through appropriate status or alert semantics.
steps.comment: Expected: interactive controls have discernible labels and feedback uses status/alert semantics. Actual: New Expense controls had explicit labels Description, Category, Amount, Date, and Receipt; the receipt hint was associated with aria-describedby. Finance exposed table aria-label 'Expenses that need attention', readable status text, and keyboard-link rows. Main navigation was labeled 'Main'. The shared toast region was always present with role=status and aria-live=polite. Empty-form submission produced one role=alert message ('Give the expense a description so your manager knows what it is.'), no success state, and no record creation.

steps.description: Repeat representative list, approval, and Finance views at narrow width.
steps.expectedResult: Tables use their guarded overflow container; controls remain reachable without page-level horizontal breakage.
steps.comment: Expected: at a narrow viewport near 375 CSS pixels, representative list, approval, and Finance views keep wide content inside guarded overflow containers; primary controls remain reachable without page-level horizontal breakage. Actual at measured 382 CSS pixels (Edge 500% zoom, devicePixelRatio 5): My Expenses document width was 449 vs client width 379; its table guard correctly had overflow-x=auto (719 scroll vs 59 client), but 6/16 visible controls extended beyond the viewport. Approvals document width was 451 vs 379 and only 5/20 controls fully fit; Open expense, Reject, Request rework, and Approve extended beyond the viewport. Finance document width was 451 vs 379; its guard correctly had overflow-x=auto (585 vs 59), but all five interactive rows extended beyond the viewport. Therefore local guarded scrolling worked, but page-level horizontal overflow and off-viewport controls violated the expected responsive behavior. Normal 100% zoom was restored and showed no document overflow (1897 scroll/client width).

cases.name: EF-REG-001 - Connected submission applies policy threshold routing

steps.description: Submit the below-threshold synthetic expense in connected mode.
steps.expectedResult: A connected Data Fabric record is created with the below-threshold outcome defined by the policy service.
steps.comment: Expected: A connected Data Fabric record is created with the below-threshold outcome defined by the policy service. Actual: the app created EXP-1001 for ₹24,000 (Travel, 22 Aug 2026). Fresh Data Fabric query returned exactly one matching record 74D6F329-1CB7-F111-A6A9-6045BDDBB45C with Amount 24000, Category 0 (Travel), Status 3 (PendingApproval), PolicyNote 'No receipt attached — manager approval required', and ApprovalTaskId 101628940. The threshold itself did not trigger the route; the missing-receipt policy did, which is an honest connected outcome.

steps.description: Submit the above-threshold synthetic expense in connected mode.
steps.expectedResult: The policy warning/routing behavior indicates manager approval is required and the record reflects the above-threshold path.
steps.comment: Expected: The policy warning/routing behavior indicates manager approval is required and the record reflects the above-threshold path. Actual: before submit, the app displayed 'Above the ₹25,000 policy threshold — this one routes to your manager for approval.' It created EXP-1002 for ₹25,001. Data Fabric returned exactly one matching record 5A111D5A-1CB7-F111-A6A9-6045BDDBB45C with Amount 25001, Status 3 (PendingApproval), PolicyNote 'No receipt attached — manager approval required', and ApprovalTaskId 101628960. Action Center independently listed task 101628960 as an Unassigned ExternalTask titled 'Approve EXP-1002 — Rahul Mehta — ₹25,001'.

steps.description: Read both created records through the app after refresh.
steps.expectedResult: Amounts, status, and persisted policy notes/routing agree with the current threshold.
steps.comment: Expected: Amounts, status, and persisted policy notes/routing agree with the current threshold after refresh. Actual: after reload, the connected app rendered EXP-1001 at ₹24,000 and EXP-1002 at ₹25,001, both Travel, 22 Aug 2026, Pending Approval, with 'No receipt attached — manager approval required' and 'Waiting on a manager in Action Center.' A fresh server query returned exactly the two run-tagged records with unchanged values and tasks 101628940/101628960, both Unassigned in folder 816862.

cases.name: EF-REG-004 - Connected receipt upload and authorized receipt access

steps.description: Attach the synthetic receipt to a valid connected expense and submit.
steps.expectedResult: Submission succeeds and the created record retains a receipt path/name.
steps.comment: Expected: Submission succeeds and the created record retains a receipt path/name. Actual: the connected form accepted the one-page non-sensitive synthetic PDF efreg004-receipt.pdf with description EFREG004-Receipt-EFQA-20260923T1248, Travel, ₹1,250, and 22 Aug 2026. The app reported EXP-1003 submitted for ₹1,250. Fresh Data Fabric query returned exactly one record FB575461-2DB7-F111-A6A9-6045BDDBB45C with Category 0 (Travel), Amount 1250, ExpenseDate 2026-08-22, Status 4 (Approved), PolicyNote 'Auto-approved under policy threshold', and ReceiptPath receipts/EXP-1003-efreg004-receipt.pdf. Authenticated bucket metadata read succeeded with ContentType application/pdf, Size 4220472, and no storage secret exposed.

steps.description: Open the created expense detail and use its receipt link.
steps.expectedResult: The receipt opens through authorized bucket access without exposing a raw storage secret.
steps.comment: Expected: The receipt opens through authorized bucket access without exposing a raw storage secret. Actual: the EXP-1003 detail rendered the receipt control titled 'Open efreg004-receipt.pdf from the ExpenseFlow_Receipts bucket'. The click-time flow was verified with a redacted window.open probe: it was called only on activation, used HTTPS with a query-bearing read URI, and no signed URI was returned or displayed in the page. Authenticated bucket download of receipts/EXP-1003-efreg004-receipt.pdf succeeded and wrote the exact stored PDF at 4220472 bytes.

cases.name: EF-REG-014 - Pagination clamps after result-set reduction

steps.description: Open My Expenses and navigate to page 2.
steps.expectedResult: Footer indicates page 2 and displays rows 26 and later.
steps.comment: Opened connected My Expenses and navigated from page 1 to page 2 of the retained pagination dataset. Verified Showing 26–34 of 34, Page 2 of 2, Previous enabled, and Next disabled.

steps.description: Apply Status, Category, or date filtering that yields fewer than 25 records.
steps.expectedResult: Table automatically renders valid page-1 results and footer indicates Page 1 of 1.
steps.comment: Applied the read-only Status=Approved filter while the list was on page 2. The table clamped to a valid single-page result set with four matching records and Showing 1–4 of 4; no blank table body or invalid page number appeared.

steps.description: Repeat the reduction from the Finance attention table.
steps.expectedResult: Finance pagination clamps to a valid page with correct disabled boundaries.
steps.comment: Finance dashboard navigation reached the connected page, but the attention table and its pager could not render. The product displayed: Something went wrong — ExpenseFlow could not load the Finance dashboard: The provided value for field [ExpenseDate] is not of date time format. This is a confirmed product failure for the retained connected dataset, not an environment-access block.

productFailures.expected: Unknown expense route renders actionable recovery UI.
productFailures.actual: Invalid expense /expenses/EXP-9999?mock=1 rendered empty body/root instead of actionable not-found state.

productFailures.expected: Narrow views keep controls reachable without page-level overflow.
productFailures.actual: At measured 382 CSS px, My Expenses, Approvals, and Finance had page-level horizontal overflow and off-viewport controls; local table guards worked.

productFailures.expected: Finance attention table clamps pagination after reduction.
productFailures.actual: Finance dashboard failed to render: The provided value for field [ExpenseDate] is not of date time format.
